text.arabic_uthmani: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

words.gloss_range: downcast, humbled, subdued, and stilled as a circumstantial state of the gazes
words.root_gloss_range: low humble submission, lowered gaze, stilled voice, and low or subsiding ground; the local phrase selects humbled/downcast sight while letting the low-still image remain felt

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: their gazes as the logical subject of the fronted state phrase

words.prose: {{ar:خَٰشِعَةً}} ({{tr:khāshiʿatan}}) opens the ayah as a fronted circumstantial state: the fallen condition is heard before {{ar:أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:abṣāruhum}}) names the bearer. Its feminine singular participle treats the many gazes as one visible field, and its active-participle form presents the lowering as an already-standing condition before the next verb makes humiliation act. The root field adds more than a modest lowered look: low submission, stillness, voice-subduing, and even low ground make the gaze feel collapsed and exposed, while the local noun keeps the selected sense visual. The phrase also joins a judgment-scene formula with {{ar:أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:abṣāruhum}}), with close echoes at 54:7, 68:43, and 79:9, so the ayah begins with a recognizable downcast-sight signal before the covering humiliation is named.

topics.headline: fronted circumstantial state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with the humbling condition before naming the gazes that bear it.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar and attachment evidence mark the word as an accusative circumstantial active participle whose logical subject follows in word 2.

topics.headline: collective gaze agreement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the shame attached specifically to the gazes as a collective field, not simply to the masculine plural people as a generic group.
topics.reason: Feminine singular agreement with the nonhuman broken plural in word 2 licenses the collective visual-field reading.

topics.headline: low-still root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lowered gaze is colored by stillness and subsiding lowliness, while the local noun keeps the active sense on sight.
topics.reason: The root has accepted low-submission and low-ground branches; local attachment to the gazes selects visual humbling and narrows the terrain image to coloring rather than a separate sense.

topics.headline: judgment-scene downcast-gaze formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the opening phrase as part of a recurring judgment-scene image of downcast sight rather than a one-off description.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete parallels at 54:7, 68:43, and 79:9, and the local syntax exactly supports the phrase pairing.

topics.headline: constricted sound texture
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound observation is plausible but adds less reader-facing value than the grammatical fronting, root image, and formulaic judgment-scene topics already retained.
topics.reason: The rows are preserved in coverage but not integrated into prose because they are mainly decorative phonetic reinforcement.

words.gloss_range: their gazes, eyesight, or perceptive faculty as the possessed subject of the humbled-state phrase
words.root_gloss_range: physical sight, seeing organ, and inner discernment are relevant; unrelated branches such as blood-trace, shield, edge, or stone-ground are not active locally
words.prose: {{ar:أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:abṣāruhum}}) supplies the nominative subject inside the circumstantial phrase, so the humbled state belongs to their gazes rather than forming a separate main clause. The suffix makes those gazes the already-tracked group's own gazes, carrying the deniers by possession instead of renaming them. The plural gathers many eyes into one collective visual field without letting the old afʿāl paucity value control the local number, and the root range keeps bodily sight primary while allowing inner discernment to collapse with it. Same-surah sight language moves from mutual visibility in 70:11 to lowered gazes here, and the downcast-gaze formula links this closing scene with 54:7, 68:43, and 79:9.

topics.headline: embedded visual subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gazes are grammatically central inside the state phrase, not a loose body-part image.
topics.reason: Attachment marks word 2 as the nominative subject of the participle in word 1.

topics.headline: possessed referent continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same group through their possessed eyes rather than through a repeated noun.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is syntactically forced and keeps the referent continuous with the prior discourse group.

topics.headline: sight and discernment collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the lowering reaches the physical gaze and also pressures the faculty of understanding, without leaving the local sense of eyes behind.
topics.reason: The accepted root branches support physical sight and inner sight; the local possessed plural with the participle selects gazes while allowing discernment as semantic pressure.

topics.headline: collective plural field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural form gathers many gazes into one collective field, while the old paucity-pattern value does not control the local number.
topics.reason: The plural form and feminine singular agreement support collective treatment; the paucity-pattern claim is narrowed to morphology background rather than a numerical reading.

topics.headline: sight thread and judgment formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the closing humbled gazes with both the surah's earlier sight scene and a wider judgment-scene formula.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah evidence at 70:11 and formula parallels at 54:7, 68:43, and 79:9.

topics.headline: long-vowel cadence
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The cadence note is plausible but does not add a distinct lexical or structural payoff beyond the retained visual-state and formula topics.
topics.reason: Preserved in coverage as low-payoff phonetic reinforcement.

words.gloss_range: it overtakes, covers, overwhelms, or presses upon them, with humiliation as the delayed subject
words.root_gloss_range: covering, pressing, overwhelming, and in other branches foolishness or reckless excess; local Form IV with humiliation as subject selects externally imposed covering pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: humiliation as the delayed subject of the overtaking verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَرْهَقُهُمْ}} ({{tr:tarhaquhum}}) shifts the ayah from prior rushing and a frozen visual state into ongoing action: humiliation is actively overtaking them. The suffix makes the same group the direct object, so pressure reaches them without a prepositional buffer, while the feminine verb waits for {{ar:ذِلَّةٌ}} ({{tr:dhillatun}}) as its delayed subject. Form IV and the imperfect keep the covering externally imposed and in progress. The root image supports covering, pressing, and overwhelming, narrowed here by the subject humiliation rather than fatigue alone, and the phrase belongs to a recurrent punishment construction with parallels at 10:27 and 68:43.

topics.headline: direct pressure on the same group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is now the direct patient of pressure, not merely described from a distance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as the direct object and ties it to the continuing plural referent.

topics.headline: humiliation as delayed agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the action of covering before the noun names humiliation as the force doing it.
topics.reason: The feminine verb agrees with the following nominative noun, making humiliation the grammatical subject after the action has already struck.

topics.headline: ongoing imposed overtaking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees humiliation as an ongoing imposed force in the displayed scene rather than a completed label.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form IV verb has a direct object and a delayed subject, supporting active externalized pressure.

topics.headline: covering-pressure root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures abasement as a covering or obscuring burden, while the local subject blocks reducing the verb to mere tiredness.
topics.reason: The accepted root branch includes covering and overwhelming; the local subject {{ar:ذِلَّةٌ}} ({{tr:dhillatun}}) narrows the sense to oppressive abasement rather than unrelated root branches.

topics.headline: formulaic humiliation overtaking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the verb with humiliation as a marked punishment-scene construction rather than a generic affliction verb.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels at 10:27 and 68:43 and note the rarity and collocational strength of the root pair.

topics.headline: scene shift into pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the transition from prior rushing and downcast state into active external pressure.
topics.reason: The verbal clause follows the nominal state phrase and binds the same referent to the surrounding shame vocabulary.

topics.headline: phonetic pressure
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The phonetic observation does not add a distinct lexical or syntactic payoff after the direct-object, Form IV, and covering-image topics.
topics.reason: Kept only in the coverage ledger as decorative sound reinforcement.

words.gloss_range: abasement, humiliation, low status, or disgrace acting as the subject that overtakes them
words.root_gloss_range: abasement under overpowering, voluntary gentleness, tractability, ease, and low-set parts; local verbal subject with overtaking selects coercive abasement, not gentle yielding

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: variant construct anchor in which humiliation is attached to that Day

words.prose: {{ar:ذِلَّةٌ}} ({{tr:dhillatun}}) arrives after the verb as the nominative subject: the pressure has already reached them, and then the ayah names humiliation as the force doing the covering. Its indefinite verbal-noun form leaves the abasement qualitatively open, not pre-packaged as a known instance, while the root field selects coercive low status rather than the gentler or tractable branches. The accepted variant reading that makes the phrase a construct with {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ}} ({{tr:dhālika al-yawmi}}) is useful contrast: base syntax makes humiliation overtake them, while that reading makes humiliation belong to the Day. Locally, the noun completes the shame field with lowered sight and the recurrent overtaking-humiliation formula found at 10:27 and 68:43.

topics.headline: humiliation as acting subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humiliation is not just a label placed on them; it is the grammatical force that overtakes them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks word 4 as the nominative subject of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: indefinite unbounded abasement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels humiliation as an open-ended quality rather than a bounded, already named instance.
topics.reason: The base reading has nominative tanwīn and is not annexed to the following demonstrative phrase.

topics.headline: variant construct contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that accepted recitation contrast exposes two ways of anchoring humiliation: acting on them in the base reading or belonging to the Day in the construct reading.
topics.reason: The variant is valid contrast for syntax and anchoring, but local base grammar remains nominative indefinite subject of the verb.

topics.headline: coercive low-status root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices loss of standing and agency, while gentler docility or ease branches stay secondary to the local humiliation scene.
topics.reason: The accepted root branches include coercive abasement and gentler yielding; the surrounding punishment pressure selects the coercive low-status branch.

topics.headline: shame-field formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects lowered sight, low status, and overtaking pressure as one local shame field.
topics.reason: The rows tie the noun to the root pair with word 3 and to the lowered-gaze field opened by word 1.

topics.headline: cadence thread
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The acoustic pairing is secondary and does not add a separate interpretive payoff beyond the retained tanwīn and shame-field topics.
topics.reason: The sound rows are preserved only as low-payoff reinforcement.

words.gloss_range: that, as a distal demonstrative gathering the displayed scene into an identifiable referent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the Day as the predicate that identifies the demonstrative

words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) pivots the ayah from depiction to identification. After humbled gazes and covering humiliation, the distal demonstrative gathers the preceding scene and the promised-day frame from 70:42 and 70:43 into one pointed referent. With {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-yawmu}}), it opens a verbless identification clause: the scene is not followed by a new event but named as that Day.

topics.headline: deictic scene gathering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative gathers the visual and verbal scene into a single identifiable referent.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the demonstrative with the following Day and links it to the surrounding eschatological frame.

topics.headline: verbless identification clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final beat as identification rather than further narration.
topics.reason: Attachment marks {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-yawmu}}) as predicated of the demonstrative in a nominal clause.

topics.headline: distal identifying weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the Day as pointed to and set apart, not merely introduced nearby.
topics.reason: The demonstrative form is distal and definite by deixis, and the following predicate supplies the name.

words.gloss_range: the Day, the identifiable temporal occasion or eschatological event
words.root_gloss_range: day, period, appointed time, event, or temporal threshold; local definiteness and relative clause identify the promised eschatological occasion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: that, the demonstrative subject gathered into the Day identification
the relative connector qualifying the definite Day

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-yawmu}}) names what {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) has gathered: not a new episode, but the definite Day already in the surah's warning frame. Its nominative definite form keeps it as the main identified referent, while the following {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) clause qualifies it. The root's time range allows more than a calendar day: after the vast duration of 70:4 and the promised-day wording of 70:42, the word lands as an appointed threshold where the displayed shame becomes fulfilled warning. The accepted genitive variant is useful contrast, because there the Day possesses humiliation, while the base reading makes the Day the predicate of identification.

topics.headline: definite Day identification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene is identified as the known Day, not introduced as some new day.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the noun as predicated of the demonstrative, and definiteness supports identity rather than indefinite event introduction.

topics.headline: parse and relative support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Day remain outside the auxiliary clause and become the antecedent qualified by the relative clause.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence keeps {{ar:كَانُوا}} ({{tr:kānū}}) governing word 9, while word 6 is the identified Day modified by the relative clause.

topics.headline: temporal threshold range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ordinary day word stretched into an eschatological threshold without losing its function as the named occasion.
topics.reason: The root range supports day, period, and event-marker senses; local definiteness and the relative clause narrow this to the promised eschatological occasion.

topics.headline: surah time and promise thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this final Day with the surah's earlier time and promise vocabulary, especially 70:4 and 70:42.
topics.reason: The rows give same-surah references at 70:4, 70:42, and 70:43, and the attachment support links the demonstrative phrase to that frame.

topics.headline: variant genitive contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant changes the Day from identified predicate to possessor of humiliation, while the base reading keeps the identification clause primary.
topics.reason: The variant is a valid syntactic contrast but does not override the base nominative predicate/apposition analysis.

topics.headline: compressed closure cadence
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The compression and sound-flow observations are lower-payoff reinforcement once the identification, temporal range, and same-surah thread are retained.
topics.reason: These rows are preserved in coverage but not integrated as separate reader-facing topics.

words.gloss_range: the singular relative connector, the one which, binding the promise-history clause to the Day

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite Day as the antecedent of the relative clause
the habitual passive promise clause qualifying the Day

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) binds the final clause to {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-yawmu}}) as its defining qualifier. The word prevents {{ar:كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:kānū yūʿadūn}}) from becoming an independent report; it turns the promise history into the adjective of the Day. Because of this connector, the ayah can move from the named Day into remembered warning and end on the promise verb.

topics.headline: relative qualification of the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause defines the Day rather than adding a separate statement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative clause a modifier of word 6.

topics.headline: bound definite-relative form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the form as a connector that demands a following qualifying clause.
topics.reason: The singular relative form matches the definite singular Day and routes the following clause adjectivally.

topics.headline: tail routed to promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move from naming the Day toward the final promise verb as its closure.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun opens the final clause and makes the promise verb the tail of the Day's qualifier.

words.gloss_range: they were, as an auxiliary forming a past habitual frame with the following passive imperfect
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, occurring, and auxiliary temporal framing; local syntax selects auxiliary government rather than full lexical existence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the passive imperfect predicate governed by the auxiliary

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) turns the final clause backward from the vivid scene into prior warning history. It is not full existential narration here; attachment evidence makes {{ar:يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yūʿadūn}}) its predicate, so the construction reads as a past habitual frame: they used to be promised. The plural verb carries the same group by morphology, and the perfect auxiliary places repeated promising inside a completed past now being fulfilled. The root's broad being-field remains as background only: locally it serves the temporal framing that makes the Day recognizable as the outcome of what had long been promised, while also joining the surah's k-w-n thread from cosmic duration and transformation at 70:4, 70:8, and 70:9 to this promise-history frame.

topics.headline: carried plural subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same group into the promise-history clause without a repeated noun.
topics.reason: The 3mp verb morphology carries the implicit subject and links it to the continuing plural referent.

topics.headline: habitual past auxiliary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the promise as repeated prior warning, not a single isolated past statement.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary governs the following imperfect passive, creating the past habitual construction.

topics.headline: auxiliary rather than full existence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the sense of prior situated being under promise while recognizing that local syntax makes the verb auxiliary.
topics.reason: The root's being field is valid background, but the governed predicate blocks treating the word as a standalone existential verb.

topics.headline: retrospective fulfillment pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scene of abasement reinterpreted as the fulfillment of earlier warnings.
topics.reason: The ayah moves from present-state and imperfect pressure into a relative clause with past habitual framing.

topics.headline: surah being-time thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the auxiliary here with the surah's earlier time and transformation uses at 70:4, 70:8, and 70:9.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references and the local clause participates in the Day-identification frame.

topics.headline: relative closure unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears {{ar:كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:kānū yūʿadūn}}) as one compact qualifier of the Day.
topics.reason: The relative clause embeds the auxiliary-passive construction inside the Day's definition.

words.gloss_range: they were being promised, warned, or held under a binding promise-threat in the passive habitual frame
words.root_gloss_range: promise, pledge, threat, warning, and appointed time; local Form IV passive in a humiliation scene leans toward fulfilled warning while retaining the certainty of promise

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the auxiliary that makes the passive promise verb habitual and retrospective

words.prose: {{ar:يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yūʿadūn}}) is the ayah's closure word, and it converts the visible humiliation into fulfilled prior speech. Passive voice foregrounds the recipients and leaves the promiser unnamed; the relative construction supplies the promised content as the Day itself, defining the Day through their repeated reception of warning rather than through a static epithet. Inside {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}), the imperfect becomes habitual and retrospective, so the phrase means that they used to be promised or warned. The root holds promise and threat together: certainty belongs to promise, while the surrounding abasement and Form IV pressure sharpen it as warning. Same-surah repetition from 70:42 to 70:44 makes the final word answer the earlier promised-Day wording, with wider eschatological formula echoes at 46:35, 51:60, and 77:7. Its plural -ūn ending carries the same group into the final cadence, so sound closure and semantic closure meet.

topics.headline: passive recipient focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar foregrounds the recipients of the promise while leaving the promiser unspoken.
topics.reason: The passive Form IV verb carries the plural subject as recipients, and attachment evidence identifies the relative pronoun as the promised content.

topics.headline: promise and threat range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains both certainty of fulfillment and warning force in the final verb.
topics.reason: The root includes promise and threat, while the local humiliation scene and Form IV passive narrow the effect toward fulfilled warning without erasing promise certainty.

topics.headline: appointed binding speech act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Day as an appointed fulfillment generated by prior speech, not merely a predicted event.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the root family to appointed promise vocabulary, and the relative clause makes the Day the promised content.

topics.headline: habitual retrospective promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears repeated prior warning now viewed from the point of fulfillment.
topics.reason: The imperfect passive sits inside the perfect auxiliary, creating the past habitual relative clause.

topics.headline: closure on promised fulfillment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end on the remembered promise rather than on humiliation alone.
topics.reason: The final word is the passive promise verb at the end of the relative clause and of the surah's closing ayah.

topics.headline: finite relative choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day is defined through their repeated reception of promise, not by a static epithet alone.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun supplies the promised object and the auxiliary-passive clause defines the Day dynamically.

topics.headline: promised-Day formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final verb with the earlier same-surah promise at 70:42 and wider eschatological formulas.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete same-surah evidence at 70:42 and cross-surah formula parallels at 46:35, 51:60, and 77:7.

topics.headline: plural cadence continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same plural group carried into the final cadence where semantic closure and sound closure meet.
topics.reason: The plural passive ending matches the carried subject and coincides with the final promise-verb closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence خاشعة أبصارهم ترهقهم ذلة binds lowered sight to an overpowering humiliation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The eyes become the visible site where an enveloping force converts status-loss into involuntary bodily submission.

activation_trace.role: Low humble submission supplies the lowered bodily posture and assigns it to the eyes.
Literal eyesight identifies the affected organ and makes the abasement visibly embodied.
Covering and overpowering supplies the pressure by which humiliation takes possession of them.
Breakage under domination specifies coerced disgrace rather than gentle humility.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes are downcast because they feel ashamed.
changed_reading.after: Humiliation acts upon them as an enveloping power that physically brings the organ of sight low.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أبصارهم can carry both eyesight and inward recognition, while خاشعة can image a luminary sinking from view.
baseline_models.mechanism: External vision and inward certainty lose their former altitude together when the severe event dominates the field of perception.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies recognition and self-witness beneath the literal lowered eyes.
A luminary sinking from sight supplies the loss of perceptual height.
An overpowering cover supplies the force that closes their former visual and inward horizon.
The day as a severe occurrence makes perception collapse before an event rather than before an abstraction.

changed_reading.before: Only the direction of their physical gaze changes.
changed_reading.after: Their physical gaze and their former inward assessment sink together under the event now seen for what it is.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون identifies the present scene as the day repeatedly held before them.
baseline_models.mechanism: A threatened appointment passes from prior speech into a severe occurrence present in time; the demonstrative closes the gap between warning and realization.

activation_trace.role: Day as a grave occurrence supplies the eventive weight of the demonstrative.
Occurrence and presence in time turns what used to be said into what now stands before them.
The threat branch specifies that the prior promise carried menace rather than open hope.
The appointed-time branch gives the warning a fixed temporal destination.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels a future day that had been predicted.
changed_reading.after: The verse points to the realized appointment: an old threat has become the severe occurrence now governing their bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised day is not only scheduled; it arrives as painful punishment that falls and settles with no successful deflection, explaining why humiliation can overtake them as a force.

activation_trace.role: Inflicted pain and penalty supplies the concrete content of the threatened appointment.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies irreversible arrival rather than a merely verbal forecast.
Pushing harm aside supplies the deflective action that the verse explicitly denies.
The appointed-time image anchors the arriving punishment in the focus promise.
Overpowering cover renders the event's arrival as pressure on the people themselves.

structural_cues: 70:1-2 opens with an asked-about punishment described as واقع and immediately negates any دافع.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: punishment, falling fixation, and negated deflection. Reader arrow: an unpushable event realizes the appointment and exerts the covering pressure in 70:44. Live alternative: the link may be juridical fulfillment rather than spatial descent.

changed_reading.before: The promised day is a date on which shame happens.
changed_reading.after: The promised day is the unpushable arrival whose settling impact becomes the humiliation covering them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lowered gaze becomes the final failure of a measuring and seeing apparatus: an immense duration was assessed as far, but the same event was near and now occupies their visual field.

activation_trace.role: A quantity reaching its set limit supplies the apparently immense temporal scale.
Eye and insight together make their judgment of distance a perceptual assessment.
The repeated seeing branch supplies the counter-assessment of the same event.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies their mistaken horizon.
Temporal nearness supplies the event's approach despite its perceived remoteness.
Inner sight anchors the failed assessment in the focus eyes.
Lowered submission gives the perceptual defeat a bodily endpoint.

structural_cues: 70:4's fifty-thousand-year measure is followed by 70:6-7's explicit opposition between their far and the speaker's near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: measured duration and two opposed acts of seeing, far versus near. Reader arrow: the downcast eyes register the collapse of their miscalibrated horizon. Live alternative: far and near may concern knowledge of timing without directly motivating the final posture.

changed_reading.before: The eyes lower in undifferentiated fear.
changed_reading.after: The eyes lower as defeated instruments of judgment when the event they placed far away becomes inescapably present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Height and solidity fail across the scene: elevated sky becomes molten matter and the hard raised mountain becomes soft wool, so the lowered human gaze reads as the local bodily register of a world-wide leveling.

activation_trace.role: Elevation supplies the high visual register that will lose stability.
Molten substances and sediment supply the sky's loss of fixed form.
A hard elevated mass supplies the stable landmark that is undone.
Soft dyed wool supplies the mountain's transformed texture and loss of resistance.
Low flattened ground supplies a material analogue for the downcast focus posture.
Literal sight locates cosmic leveling in the human visual field.

structural_cues: The parallel وتكون clauses of 70:8-9 transform sky and mountains through paired material similes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: elevated sky, molten matter, hard mountain, and soft wool. Reader arrow: the focus gaze is the human-scale continuation of that leveling. Live alternative: the cosmic and bodily changes may be juxtaposed consequences without an analogical arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: Downcast eyes are an isolated emotional gesture.
changed_reading.after: The eyes participate in the same collapse of height and firmness that has already overtaken the visible world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forced visibility activates a failed social exchange: intimate relations are made perceptible, then offered as substitutes, yet no separation secures escape; the lowered eyes therefore carry exposed relational betrayal as well as fear.

activation_trace.role: Literal seeing supplies forced recognition of the people one would trade away.
Making one thing ransom another supplies the attempted substitution of relations for self.
Escape by separation supplies the desired result that the expanding ransom cannot achieve.
Inner sight turns the final lowered eyes into self-witness after forced recognition.
Humiliation under power supplies the public consequence of the failed exchange.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 expands the proposed ransom from children through spouse, brother, clan, and everyone on earth before the wished-for rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: made-visible relations, substitution, and escape by separation. Reader arrow: the final eyes lower under exposed willingness to sacrifice every bond. Live alternative: the ransom list may indicate terror alone rather than relational shame.

changed_reading.before: The final humiliation is private dread before punishment.
changed_reading.after: The final humiliation is also public self-recognition after every intimate bond has been mentally offered for escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sequence of self-protective concealment and containment reverses direction: truth is covered and goods are enclosed, but punishment strips what is fixed in place and humiliation becomes the cover that cannot be controlled.

activation_trace.role: Blocking truth supplies the initial act of controlled concealment.
Pulling something from its settled place supplies punitive exposure and stripping.
Enclosing a thing in a vessel supplies the hoarder's chosen mode of containment.
An overpowering cover reverses concealment by making humiliation the container around them.
Coerced abasement specifies the content of the uncontrollable final cover.

structural_cues: 70:16-18 moves from stripping extremities to calling the one who turned away, gathered, and stored.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: concealment, extraction, storage, and overpowering cover. Reader arrow: chosen covering and containment invert into exposure followed by an imposed cover. Live alternative: these may be cumulative punishments without a measure-for-measure reversal.

changed_reading.after: Humiliation is an inverted covering: those who concealed and contained are stripped, then enclosed by the disgrace they cannot manage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The central exception separates two kinds of low posture: sustained chosen worship joined to fearful care culminates in honor, while the focus lowering is delayed, imposed, and explicitly joined to disgrace.

activation_trace.role: The specific act of worship supplies a repeated voluntary bodily orientation.
Care mixed with fear supplies anticipatory responsiveness before the day arrives.
Honored nobility supplies the outcome paired with chosen discipline.
Humble lowering anchors the shared posture while leaving its voluntariness open.
Breakage under domination resolves the focus posture as compulsory disgrace.

structural_cues: The exception إلا المصلين begins the central list, repeated prayer language frames it at 70:23 and 70:34, and 70:35 closes with honor.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The gaze finally lowers under coercion.** *Khāshiʿatan* activates **خ ش ع, B001, “low humble submission,”** specifically lowered gaze and bodily stilling. The structural reversal runs from their fixed forward gaze in **ه ط ع B001** (70:36) to eyes now lowered. I infer that what voluntary attention did not accomplish, encounter imposes on the body. The ayah reads as coerced recognition made visible in the eyes.

2. **Abasement arrives as an overwhelming cover.** *Tarhaquhum* activates **ر ه ق, B001, “covering or overwhelming a thing,”** and *dhillah* activates **ذ ل ل, B001, “abasement under overpowering.”** Grammar supplies the covering action and abasement as its subject; I infer the directional arrow from moral exposure to an all-enveloping social-bodily condition. Humiliation is therefore not merely felt inwardly but settles over and masters them.

3. **The near event catches up with those who called it far.** **ر ه ق, B002, “nearing and catching up,”** is activated by 70:6–7 and the repeated promise in 70:42 and this ayah. I infer that the promised day behaves like a pursuer reaching those who mistook delay for distance. The closing identification, *dhālika al-yawmu*, reads as the completed correction of their original temporal perception.

4. **Their hurry and their humiliation form one yielded motion.** **ذ ل ل, B007, “hurried yielding motion,”** is a rare branch activated by the immediate *yūfiḍūn* of 70:43. Exploratorily, I infer that speed is no longer agency but compliance under the event’s pull. This reading keeps bodily motion and social abasement causally joined.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remains. The final line instead retrospectively gathers the far/near dispute (70:6–7), the promise of meeting (70:42), and the compelled rush (70:43) into one completed arrival.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Claimant, deprived person, and open provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A requester approaches, a deprived person lacks access, and wealth exits as alms or generous hospitality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: requester `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; desired need `quranic:root_000661:B002/m01`; discharged petition `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`; inviolable claim `quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`; deprivation from hoped-for provision `quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`; alms as truthful transfer `quranic:root_000852:B006/m01`; gift and generosity `quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`; noble generosity `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; a host crowded by guests and askers `quranic:root_000606:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The claimant scene has both legal and household dimensions. Right protects the request, alms moves property outward, and hospitality receives the approaching person. Generosity is not opposed to obligation; it is the social form in which obligation becomes provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Debt, Promise, and the Appointed Settlement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A future claim binds the present through debt, truthful commitment, trust, and a fixed time of encounter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eschatological promise becomes a ledger of loan, entitlement, mutual undertaking, due date, and collection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Threat arriving at its appointment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Warning signs intensify until the addressee meets the harmful event at its stated time.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: threatening warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`; stallion's warning before attack `quranic:root_001662:B005/m01`; signs promising a coming condition `quranic:root_001662:B006/m01`; face-to-face encounter `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; experienced adversity `quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`; catastrophic day `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; punitive pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; sovereign owner `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `70:27-28` عَذَاب رَبِّهِم (`ع ذ ب`, `ر ب ب`); `70:42` يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُم الَّذِي يُوعَدُون (`ل ق ي`, `ي و م`, `و ع د`); `70:44` الْيَوْم الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُون (`ي و م`, `و ع د`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Threat develops like an animal warning before charge: a signal, a voiced menace, advancing harm, then encounter. The promised day is not merely reached on a calendar; it meets the person as an experienced event.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Fear Before Judgment and Humiliation After It
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Careful fear anticipates an unsecured danger; when the danger arrives, it surrounds, lowers, and visibly masters the body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Twilight, exposed frontier, pursuing pressure, sinking star, lost hump, low hem, and struck peg all specify the transition from vigilance to abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pressure that closes over the body
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A pursuing burden catches the person, overwhelms him, lowers his profile, and leaves him under imposed disgrace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: overwhelming and mastering `quranic:root_000606:B001/m01`; burdensome imposition `quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`; time narrowing toward loss `quranic:root_000606:B004/m01`; subjugated abasement `quranic:root_000519:B001/m01`; low hanging hem or structure `quranic:root_000519:B005/m01`; peg battered by blows `quranic:root_000519:B006/m01`; bodily lowering and downcast gaze `quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`; hump deprived of its height `quranic:root_000412:B004/m01`; submissive fear `quranic:root_001594:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `70:36` مُهْطِعِين (`ه ط ع`); `70:44` خَاشِعَة أَبْصَارُهُم تَرْهَقُهُم ذِلَّة (`خ ش ع`, `ب ص ر`, `ر ه ق`, `ذ ل ل`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Humiliation is a force with direction and load. It catches, imposes weight, drives the body down, removes the hump's proud height, and makes the person receive blows like a peg. The abstract noun becomes visible posture.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Fear Before Judgment and Humiliation After It
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Careful fear anticipates an unsecured danger; when the danger arrives, it surrounds, lowers, and visibly masters the body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Twilight, exposed frontier, pursuing pressure, sinking star, lost hump, low hem, and struck peg all specify the transition from vigilance to abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eye, horizon, and sinking light
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A fixed forward gaze gives way to streaming eyes, sinking celestial bodies, and lowered sight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ocular sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward discernment `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; prolonged forward gaze `quranic:root_001594:B001/m01`; projected head and neck `quranic:root_001594:B002/m01`; tear channels at the eye's edges `quranic:root_001077:B004/m01`; sharp wet edges of teeth `quranic:root_001077:B005/m01`; star sinking toward setting `quranic:root_000412:B003/m01`; twilight glow `quranic:root_000803:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The crowd first projects eye, head, and neck forward; at the endpoint, sight sinks. Tear channels and setting light translate the reversal into a horizon inside the face, where the gaze reaches its own west.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Witness, Knowledge, and Truth Made Public
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Private perception becomes reliable public evidence by being remembered, marked, spoken, and embodied in a standing witness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Evidence includes bodily presence, tongue, landmark, memory, eye-sign, truthful performance, and exposure of fabricated interiors.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Witness present and standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A witness is present, sees, rises, and gives a decisive account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: presence with direct observation `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`; informed declaration `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; tongue as visible witness `quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`; indicating sign `quranic:root_000822:B008/m01`; bodily standing `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; rising to an affair `quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`; maintaining a charge `quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`; inward discernment `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `70:44` أَبْصَار (`ب ص ر`); `70:33` شَهَادَاتِهِم قَائِمُون (`ش ه د`, `ق و م`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Testimony requires more than speech. Presence supplies access, sight supplies basis, standing supplies public commitment, and the tongue makes the inwardly known account available to judgment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Desire for an interior can be manipulated by a visible lure, converting self-directed approach into capture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Garden entry becomes a hunting scene with decoy bird, set snare, raised marker, game, and protective screen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Screen and shield cannot create belonging
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A would-be entrant equips himself with cover, shield, or tent, but these defenses only hide and do not authorize entry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: protective shield `quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`; armor `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; mosquito-screen tent `quranic:root_001315:B006/m01`; material covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; rhetorical concealment `quranic:root_001642:B005/m01`; concealed sword under a garment `quranic:root_000819:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cover and shield can prevent contact or detection, but they cannot establish a rightful place inside. The concealed weapon even makes defensive appearance compatible with hostile intent, sharpening the difference between protected residence and disguised intrusion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rule over recurring horizons establishes the capacity to redesign and replace a population before it can escape.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic horizon, legal division, measured design, proxy, changed form, and footrace are one executable proof.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Recurrent eastings and westings
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Light rises and sets across multiple horizon points, making daily recurrence a visible domain of rule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rising light and eastern horizon `quranic:root_000790:B001/m01`; sunlit place of prayer `quranic:root_000790:B006/m01`; setting sun and western horizon `quranic:root_001077:B006/m01`; exile into distance `quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`; rare or unfamiliar object `quranic:root_001077:B008/m01`; unguided projectile from an unknown source `quranic:root_001077:B013/m01`; far-flying portent `quranic:root_001077:B014/m01`; bounded day `quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`; temporal duration `quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`; twilight `quranic:root_000803:B002/m01`; sinking celestial body `quranic:root_000412:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Plural horizons make recurrence spatially visible: each day rises and sets at a shifted point. Exile, unknown-source arrow, and distant portent extend the horizon into domains from which events appear unexpectedly, yet all remain inside the same rule.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Aimless activity immerses its participants in a mixed medium until the promised event interrupts and gathers the scattered motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Futile discourse becomes water-crossing, stirred drink, saliva, venom, wind-erased ground, discarded object, and joined endpoints.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Leaving ends at a forced meeting
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Persons are temporarily left in motion, but discarded states and separated endpoints are gathered into one encounter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: leaving or abandoning `quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`; face-to-face meeting `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; throwing or casting `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; discarded object `quranic:root_001372:B006/m01`; experienced adversity `quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`; lying on the back `quranic:root_001372:B009/m01`; joining two endpoints `quranic:root_001372:B010/m01`; receiving a communicated word `quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`; fixed appointment `quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`; demonstrative pointing `quranic:root_000527:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `70:42` ذَرْهُم، يُلَاقُوا، يُوعَدُون (`و ذ ر`, `ل ق ي`, `و ع د`); surface anchor unavailable for `ذ و و` in `70:44`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: “Leave them” is temporary permission, not an open destination. Casting, discard, and prone collapse describe the states reached along the way; joining endpoints and meeting show how the promised appointment closes the interval.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Grave Exit, Target-Rush, and Exhausted Finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Burial enclosure opens into accelerated collective movement toward a raised objective, ending in bodily lowering and fatigue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Resurrection becomes exhumation, race start, vanguard, quiver, erected target, all-day march, stopped limbs, and missed deadline.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Motion spent into stoppage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sustained travel exhausts the body, hardens movement into stoppage, and closes the available time.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exhausting toil `quranic:root_001507:B004/m01`; all-day but gentle march `quranic:root_001507:B010/m01`; fatigue and blunted force `quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`; frozen or stopped movement `quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`; limb disease forcing an animal to stand `quranic:root_001273:B020/m01`; burdensome imposition `quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`; narrowing time and feared loss `quranic:root_000606:B004/m01`; compliant haste `quranic:root_000519:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Speed does not remain triumphant. March produces toil, fatigue dulls force, limbs arrest motion, and time closes around the runner. Final haste is compliant rather than self-directed: the crowd moves quickly because it can no longer choose its pace.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Joint, Support, and the Upright Load
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A stable order depends on fitted joints and upright supports that distribute weight without opening a dangerous gap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hip socket, interlocked flesh, shoe straps, rib cage, chest, table leg, well apparatus, straight path, exact weight, crossbeam, and exhausted support form one structural field.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fitted joints around a gap
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate components meet at seams and joints, leaving controlled openings while forming a load-bearing body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fitting joint or socket `quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`; interlocking tissue and joints `quranic:root_000464:B008/m01`; paired straps and joined parts `quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`; opening between components `quranic:root_001139:B001/m01`; stitched panels `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; rib-cage bones `quranic:root_000266:B016/m01`; chest flesh `quranic:root_000095:B003/m01`; chest as structural front `quranic:root_001315:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Stability is not seamlessness. Socket, seam, strap, rib, and chest permit distinct pieces to move together while controlling their gaps. Guarding an aperture is thus analogous to maintaining a joint: openness is functional only when its boundary remains fitted.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A breached body can swell, suppurate, transmit harm, and lose the alignment needed for free movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Incision, boil, lung disease, facial palsy, spreading wound, transmitted illness, chest frame, long neck, eye swelling, and overloaded limbs form a clinical scene.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Contact and transmitted affliction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Harm reaches by touch, spreads from one body to another, and imposes a burden beyond ordinary capacity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: madness-like affliction by touch `quranic:root_001423:B003/m01`; adverse impact `quranic:root_001423:B004/m01`; disease crossing between bodies `quranic:root_000993:B006/m01`; concealed internal defect `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`; bodily disease `quranic:root_001077:B017/m01`; forced burden beyond capacity `quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`; corrupt wound spreading past its boundary `quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Contact is the path by which a local defect becomes relational harm. Touch, transmission, internal concealment, and boundary-crossing explain why guarding is preventative care, while imposed burden describes the endpoint when the body can no longer contain the process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority is legitimate when dominion, obedience, nurture, standing administration, and corrective replacement remain joined.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religion, debt, city, ruler, ship-master, dependent ward, public office, station, and reform form one polity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: City, station, and maintained presence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rule becomes durable by assigning known places where people remain, gather, and receive provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: city of obedience `quranic:root_000504:B006/m01`; station and residence `quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`; place and rank `quranic:root_001332:B002/m01`; fitting residence `quranic:root_001525:B011/m01`; known returning place `quranic:root_001055:B005/m01`; public assembly and presence `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Government requires a spatial memory: city, station, recognized meeting place, and fitting residence allow obligations and provision to recur. A polity is maintained presence, not only episodic command.

pericope.label: Human anxiety, faithful prayer, and final warning

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu tanıklık, insanın başını, bedenini ya da bakışını aşağı indirerek boyun eğmesini temel alır; bu durum sesin durulmasına ve içteki yakarışın organlara yansımasına da uzanır. Verilen çerçeve bu bedensel, davranışsal ve sessel görünümleri aynı alçalma ve boyun eğme çekirdeğinde doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insanın boyun eğen ve sakinleşen durumuyla sınırlıdır; arazi, gök cisimleri, deve hörgücü ve göğüsten salgı çıkarma anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler genel boyun eğme ve alçalma durumunu verir; bakışın indirilmesi, seslerin dinmesi ve organların etkilenmesi yalnız kendi yapıları içinde yorumlanır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin boyun eğerek başını, bedenini veya bakışını aşağı indirmesi ve dingin bir tutum almasıdır. Bu iç yöneliş, belirli yapılarda sesin alçalması ya da organların sakinleşmiş duruşuyla görünür olur.

facets.statement: Kişi kendini alçaltan bir tutumla boyun eğer ve dinginleşir.
Başın, göğsün veya bakışın aşağı indirilmesi bu tutumun bedensel görünümüdür.
Seslere uygulandığında seslerin kesilmesini, durulmasını ve alçalmasını bildirir.
İçteki yakarış ve boyun eğiş, organların sakin ve alçalmış duruşunda dışa vurabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar alçalma, boyun eğme ve dinginlik çekirdeğinde birleşir; baş, göğüs, bakış, ses ve organlar bu çekirdeğin farklı görünüm alanlarıdır. Kimi kullanımlarda eğilerek durma, kimi kullanımlarda ise böyle görünmeye çalışma ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanın kendini alçaltan iç ve dış tutumunu, bedensel sakinlikle birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğme, alçalma ve dinginleşme çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başın ya da bakışın yere yöneltildiği bedensel görünüm için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aşağı yönelen baş ve bakış hareketini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Seslerin kesildiği, sakinleştiği ve işitilirliğinin azaldığı yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin durulması ve alçalması sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İçteki boyun eğişin organların sakin duruşunda görünür olduğu bağlamı açıklar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bedene, sese ve bakışa yayılan sakinleşmiş alçalma görünümü vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sinmişlik ve güçsüzce boyun eğme vurgusu daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dingin boyun eğiş / sinerek boyun eğiş
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin kendini alçaltıp boyun eğmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, boyun eğişin baş, beden, bakış, ses ve organlarda beliren dingin görünümünü kapsar. Komşu dal ise boyun eğmeyi özellikle sinmiş ve güçsüz bir durumda kalma yönüyle sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir hareket olmadan da sürebilen dingin ve alçalmış durumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eğilme hareketini hem tapınmada hem başka durumlarda kullanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de bedenin aşağı yönelmesi kendini alçaltma anlamı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir kişinin genel tutumunu ve bunun bakış, ses ve organlardaki belirtilerini anlatır. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise doğrudan eğilme hareketidir; bu yüzden sıradan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Baş, bakış veya sesin alçalmasıyla da gerçekleşebilen geniş bir durumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Alnı yere koymaya kadar varan belirli bir yere kapanma hareketini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bedenin alçalması boyun eğmenin görünür belirtisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın gerçekleşmesi için alnın yere konması gerekmez; dinginlik ve bakışın ya da sesin alçalması yeterli olabilir. Komşu dal ise yere kapanmanın belirli bedensel hareketini ve bu hareketle bildirilen boyun eğmeyi merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: İnsanın boyun eğişiyle doğrudan karışabilecek üç aday seçildi. Koşma, diz çökme ve belirli el ya da baş işaretleri ayrı hareket çekirdeklerine sahipti; öteki adaylar ya korku ve uysallık gibi daha dar durumları veriyor ya da yalnız aynı kökün fiziksel alçalma dallarını temsil ediyordu.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على التطامن؛ تطامن وطأطا رأسه؛ الخاشع المستكين والراكع (maqayis)؛ الخشوع رميك ببصرك إلى الأرض؛ متخشع متضرع؛ خشعت الأصوات أي سكنت (ayn)؛ الخاشع المستكين؛ الخاشع الراكع؛ خشع ببصره إذا غضه (jamhara)؛ الخشوع الخضوع؛ التخشع تكلف الخشوع (sihah)؛ التخشع لله الإخبات والتذلل؛ خشع الرجل إذا رمى ببصره إلى الأرض؛ الخشوع في البدن والصوت والبصر (tahdhib)؛ الخشوع الضراعة؛ إذا ضرع القلب خشعت الجوارح (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili tanıklık yalnız cansız ve kuru toprağı değil, yere yakın bir arazi parçasını veya küçük yükseltiyi; ayrıca yapıya bağlı olarak tozlu yöreyi, kurumuş toprağı ve çöküp yere yaklaşan duvarı kapsar. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak onu yalnızca alçak ve cansız arazi diye sunan görüntü daha geniş ve katmanlı bir tanımla düzeltilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yere yakın arazi adı dalın yalın çekirdeğidir; kuruluk, tozluluk ve duvarın çökmesi yalnız ilgili adlarla kurulan yapılara aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad, yere yakın arazi parçasını veya küçük yükseltiyi belirtir; yöre, toprak ve duvarla kurulan kullanımların tozluluk, kuruluk ve çökme anlamları bu ada genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalın kullanımda yere yakın duran bir arazi parçasını, sırtı veya küçük yükseltiyi belirtir; tanıklıklar yüzeyin düzleşmiş ya da pürüzlü oluşunda ayrışır. Belirli yapılarda bu alçalma görüntüsü tozlu ve yerleşimsiz yöreye, kuruyup cansızlaşmış toprağa veya çökerek yerle bir olan duvara uygulanır.

facets.statement: Yere yakın duran arazi parçası, sırt veya küçük yükselti yalın adın çekirdeğidir.
Arazi parçası kimi tanıklıkta düzleşmiş ve kolay geçilir, kiminde pürüzlü olarak betimlenir.
Yöre veya yer için kullanıldığında tozlu ve yerleşimsiz olmayı bildirir.
Toprak için kullanıldığında yağmursuz kalıp kurumuş, bitkisiz ve cansız duruma gelmeyi bildirir.
Duvar için kullanıldığında çöküp yüksekliğini yitirerek yer düzeyine inmeyi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yere yakınlık ve alçalmış görünüm çevresinde birleşir. Bunun yanında arazi parçasının düz ya da pürüzlü oluşunda ayrışır; tozlu ve boş yöre, yağmursuz kalmış bitkisiz toprak ve çökmüş duvar kullanımları da aynı toplu iddiada yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın adın arazi parçası, sırt veya küçük yükselti bildiren ortak çekirdeği için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi türünü ve yere yakın duruşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yöre veya yerleşim alanının tozlu ve üzerinde ev bulunmayan durumunu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Tozlu ve yerleşimsiz yöre niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yağmur almayan toprağın kuruduğu ve üzerinde yeşillik kalmadığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuruma, bitkisizleşme ve cansızlaşma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir duvarın yüksekliğini yitirerek yere yaklaşması veya yer düzeyine inmesi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duvarın çökmesi ve yüksekliğini yitirmesi sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yere yakın arazi parçası veya küçük yükselti
yere yakın, basık sırt veya yükselti

error_profile.preserves: Kurumuş ve bitkisiz toprak görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yere yakın arazi adını, tozlu yöreyi ve çökmüş duvar kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.collision: Toprağın verimsizliğiyle sınırlı ayrı bir kavramı çağrıştırır.

error_profile.preserves: Bazı tanıklıklardaki düzleşmiş arazi görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Pürüzlü arazi değişkesini ve yere yakın küçük yükseltiyi eksiltir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yere yakın küçük yükseltiyi, tozlu yöreyi ve çökmüş duvarı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle dümdüz, pürüzsüz ve bazen bitkisiz geniş alanı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal düzleşmiş veya bitkisiz görünen araziyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın yalın adı yere yakın bir arazi parçası ya da küçük yükselti olabilir ve yüzey her zaman pürüzsüz değildir. Komşu dal ise özellikle düz, pürüzsüz geniş alanı merkez alır; bitkisizlik onun olası bir niteliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yere yakın arazi biçimini ve çökmüş duvar gibi başka alçalmış görünümleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bitkinin yağmursuzluk, yenme veya başka nedenle kesilmiş olmasını merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kurumuş ve üzerinde bitki kalmamış toprağı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda bitkisizlik yalnız toprağa bağlı uzantılardan biridir; yalın çekirdek yere yakın arazi biçimidir. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise bitki örtüsünün ortadan kalkmasıdır ve arazinin alçak olmasını gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Küçük yükselti, pürüzlü parça, kuru toprak ve çökmüş duvar görünümlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kolay geçilen düz araziyi ve böyle bir araziye inmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yere yakın parça / kolay geçilen düzlük
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de düzleşmiş ve alçak görünen arazi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yere yakınlık çevresinde farklı arazi biçimlerini ve yapıya bağlı uzantıları toplar. Komşu dal ise engebeli arazinin karşıtı olan kolay geçilir düzlüğü merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Doğrudan arazi biçimi veya bitkisizlik kesişimi bulunan üç aday seçildi. Yüksek arazi, verimli çukur, dağlara giriş ve kumluk gibi öteki alan kartları yalnız aynı çevreyi paylaşır; insan, gök cismi ve hörgüç dallarıysa fiziksel alçalma imgesine rağmen ayrı çekirdeklere sahiptir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخشعة من الأرض والقف الخاشع والأكمة المتواضعة والبلدة المغبرة والمكان الخاشع والأرض الخاشعة الهامدة والجدار المتداعي
branches.what_is_not_ar: خشوع الإنسان والصوت والبصر والسنام والكواكب وخراشي الصدر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخشعة قطعة من الأرض قف قد غلبت عليه السهولة؛ قف خاشع لاطئ بالأرض؛ بلدة خاشعة مغبرة (maqayis)؛ الخشعة قف غلبت عليه السهولة؛ أكمة خاشعة لاطئة بالأرض (ayn)؛ الخشعة قطعة من الأرض تغلظ؛ الخاشع المطمئن من الأرض (jamhara)؛ بلدة خاشعة مغبرة؛ مكان خاشع؛ الخشعة أكمة متواضعة (sihah)؛ الحثمة اللاطئة بالأرض هي الخشعة؛ الخشعة الأكمة؛ إذا يبست الأرض ولم تمطر قيل قد خشعت؛ أرض خاشعة هامدة؛ جدار خاشع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklık iki göksel yapıyı birlikte verir: güneş söz konusu olduğunda tutulma veya kararma, yıldızlar söz konusu olduğunda ufka inip gözden kaybolmaya yaklaşma. Yıldızın batışını öne çıkaran dal görüntüsü kullanılabilir, ancak güneş tutulmasını aynı olaymış gibi göstermemek için iki yapı açıkça ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız verilen güneş ve yıldız yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kararma, düşme veya batma anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız güneşin tutulmasını ve yıldızların ufka inmesini bildiren iki göksel yapıyla sınırlıdır; bunlardan yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız gök cisimleriyle kurulan yapılarda, güneşin tutulup kararmasını veya yıldızların ufka inerek gözden kaybolmaya yaklaşmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Gök cisminin görünürlüğü ya kararma ya da ufka iniş yoluyla azalır.
Güneşle kurulan yapıda tutulma, kararma ve görünürlüğün azalması anlatılır.
Yıldızlarla kurulan yapıda ufka iniş ve batmaya yaklaşma anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dalın bütün verisi tek bir tanıklık kümesinde iki ayrı göksel yapıya ayrılır; güneş için tutulma, yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolma bildirilir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, güneş için tutulmayı; yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolmayı bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız güneş tutulması ile yıldızların ufka inişini birlikte kapsayan üst anlatım olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her iki yapıda da görünürlüğün azalması ve kaybolmaya yaklaşma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güneşin tutulduğu veya bu olayda kararıp görünürlüğünün azaldığı yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin tutulması ve kararması olayını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yıldızların ufka inip gözden kaybolmaya yaklaştığı yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yıldızların ufka inişini ve batmaya yaklaşmasını korur.
Yıldızların ufka inip gözden kaybolması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Güneşin ufka iniş olmadan tutulup kararması anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Işığın görünürlükten çekilmesi sonucunu kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Güneş tutulması ile yıldızın ufka inişi arasındaki iki ayrı süreci siler.
error_profile.adds: Işık kaynağının bütünüyle çalışmaz duruma geldiği izlenimini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ateşin veya yapay bir ışığın sönmesiyle karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulmasını ve yıldızların batmaya yaklaşmasını birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Güneşin ufukta gerçekleşen olağan batışını doğrudan belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal güneşin görünürlüğünün azalabildiği bir durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda güneşin görünürlüğü tutulma nedeniyle azalır; ayrıca yıldızların ufka inişi de bu dala bağlıdır. Komşu dal ise güneşin ufukta batıp kaybolmasını merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulması ve yıldızların batmaya yaklaşmasıyla sınırlı iki yapı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyin yokluğa çekilmesini ve çeşitli ışıklı gök cisimlerinin batışını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yapıya bağlı kaybolma / genel gözden yitme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güneş veya yıldızın görünmez duruma gelmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız iki belirli göksel yapıda tutulma veya ufka iniş bildirir. Komşu dalın çekirdeği daha genel gözden yitme ve batmadır; bu yüzden gök dışındaki varlıklara da uzanabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulmasını veya yıldızların ufka inmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayın evre sonunda ışığının giderek azalmasıyla görünmezleşmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: tutulma ya da batış / ayın küçülerek görünmezleşmesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal göksel bir ışığın görünürlüğünün azalması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın süreçleri güneş tutulması ve yıldızların ufka hareketidir. Komşu dal ise ayın aylık evresinde ışıklı bölümünün küçülmesini anlatır; ortak sonuç benzer olsa da süreç ve gök cismi farklıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Görünmezleşme sonucunu taşıyıp süreç farkını açıklayan üç aday seçildi. Doğuş, ateş ışığı, gezegenlerin geri hareketi ve güneşin gökteki başka konum değişimleri farklı çekirdeklere sahipti; kardeş dallar ise yalnız alçalma imgesi üzerinden uzaktan bağlantılıydı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خشوع الشمس إذا كسفت أو خسفت وخشوع الكواكب إذا غارت أو دنت من المغيب
branches.what_is_not_ar: خشوع الإنسان والأرض والسنام وخراشي الصدر
branches.source_phrase_ar: خشعت الشمس وكسفت وخسفت بمعنى واحد؛ خشوع الكواكب إذا غارت فكادت تغيب في مغيبها؛ خشعت الكواكب إذا دنت من المغيب (tahdhib)

source_note.TA: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, güneş için tutulmayı; yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolmayı bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklıklar devenin hörgücündeki yağın tükenmesini, geriye çok az bölüm kalmasını ve tepenin aşağı çökmesini birlikte bildirir. Verilen dal görüntüsü hem süreci hem de ortaya çıkan biçim değişikliğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız devenin hörgücüyle kurulan yapıya aittir; genel zayıflama, kesme veya yüksekliğini yitirme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız devenin hörgücündeki yağ kaybını ve buna bağlı çökmeyi bildiren yapıyla sınırlıdır; yalın bir zayıflama anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devenin hörgücünün yağını yitirip büyük ölçüde erimesi ve tepesinin aşağı çökmesidir.

facets.statement: Devenin hörgücündeki yağ tükenir ve hörgüçten yalnız az bir bölüm kalır.
Yağ kaybının sonucu olarak hörgücün tepesi belirginliğini yitirip aşağı çöker.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar hörgücün büyük ölçüde erimesinde birleşir; daha ayrıntılı anlatım yağın tükenmesini ve hörgüç tepesinin aşağı çökmesini aynı sürecin aşamaları olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin hörgücündeki yağ kaybını ve bunun sonucundaki biçim değişikliğini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağın tükenmesi ile tepenin aşağı çökmesi arasındaki süreci korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir devenin hörgücü yağını yitirip geriye çok azı kaldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hörgücün erimesini ve aşağı çökmesini birlikte korur.
Yağ kaybı ve küçülme yönünü genel olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Deve hörgücünün tepesinin çökmesi sonucunu açıkça göstermez.
error_profile.adds: Bütün bedenin veya herhangi bir varlığın güç ve ağırlık kaybetmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Hayvanın genel olarak zayıflamasıyla karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Hörgüç tepesinin aşağı yönelmesi sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu sonucu doğuran yağ tükenmesini ve hörgücün büyük ölçüde erimesini eksiltir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yağ kaybını özellikle deve hörgücünde ve tepenin çökmesi sonucuyla anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanın veya bedenin genel olarak yağını ve dolgunluğunu yitirmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda yağ kaybı görünür bir küçülmeye yol açar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız deve hörgücünün yağını yitirip çökmesini bildirir. Komşu dal bütün bedenin zayıflamasını merkez alır; hörgücün özel biçim değişikliğini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hörgücün yağını yitirerek küçülmesini ve aşağı çökmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Devenin etle dolmasını ve bedenin ya da hörgücün dolgunlaşmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal devenin beden veya hörgücündeki dolgunluk derecesini karşıt yönlerden ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dolgunluğun kaybı ve çökmeyle sonuçlanan eksilme kutbundadır. Komşu dal ise etle dolma ve sıkılaşma kutbundadır; kapsamları tam örtüşmese de aynı doluluk ekseninde karşı karşıya gelirler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hörgüç kendiliğinden yağını yitirir ve tepesi çöker.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hörgücün bir parçasının dışarıdan kesilmesini veya kesilmiş parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aynı beden bölümündeki küçülme veya eksilmeyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal besisel tükenme sonucu oluşan erime ve çökmeyi anlatır. Komşu dalın çekirdeği dışarıdan yapılan kesme işlemidir; ortak beden bölümü, işlemleri eş anlamlı kılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yağ kaybı, karşıt dolgunluk ve aynı beden bölümündeki kesme işlemini ayıran üç aday seçildi. Yükseklik, hörgücün anatomik adı, kemik iliği ve hayvan besleme kartları aynı alanı paylaşsa da doğrudan anlam karışıklığı yaratmıyordu; kardeş dallar farklı varlık ve süreçlere bağlıydı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خشوع سنام البعير إذا ذهب شحمه أو لم يبق منه إلا القليل وتطأطأ شرفه
branches.what_is_not_ar: خشوع الإنسان والأرض والكواكب وخراشي الصدر
branches.source_phrase_ar: خشع سنام البعير إذا ذهب إلا أقله (maqayis)؛ خشع سنام البعير إذا أنضي فذهب شحمه وتطأطأ شرفه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklıklar kişinin göğsünden gelen yapışkan bir salgıyı çıkarıp dışarı atması üzerinde birleşir. Bir aktarım, fiilin bu yapıda nesne alan ve başka yerde duyulmamış bir kullanım olduğunu ayrıca belirtir; bu kayıt dalın bağımsız bir genel anlam değil, sınırlı bir söz öbeği olduğunu doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgının çıkarılmasını bildiren eski söz öbeğine aittir; genel tükürme, öksürme veya kusma anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgıyı dışarı atmayı bildiren söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır; fiile yalın bir çıkarma veya tükürme anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgıyı çıkarıp ağız yoluyla dışarı atmaktır.

facets.statement: Kişi göğsünden gelen bir salgıyı çıkarıp dışarı atar.
Çıkarılan göğüs salgısının yapışkan olduğu özellikle belirtilir.
Bir aktarım, kullanımı nesne alan ve başka yerde işitilmemiş sınırlı bir yapı olarak kaydeder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar göğüsten yapışkan bir salgı çıkarıp atma anlamında birleşir. Toplu iddia ayrıca fiilin nesne aldığı ve kullanımın seyrek ya da belirli bir aktarımla sınırlı görüldüğü yönünde bir dil bilgisi kaydı içerir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgının ağız yoluyla çıkarılıp dışarı atılmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Salgının göğüsten gelişini, yapışkanlığını ve dışarı atılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin göğsünden ağzına gelen koyu salgıyı çıkarıp attığı durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynak bölgeyi, salgının niteliğini ve atma eylemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgıyı çıkarıp atmak

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapışkan bir beden salgısının gerçekten çıkarılmasını bildiren sınırlı bir yapıdır. Komşu dal göğüstekini dışarı atma olayını daha genel verir ve bunu sözün ya da sıkıntının açığa vurulmasına taşıyan atasözü kullanımına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal göğüs kaynaklı yapışkan salgının bilinçli biçimde atılmasını anlatır. Komşu dalın maddesi mide içeriğidir ve temel olay kusmadır; kaynak organ ile çıkarılan madde farklıdır.

Göğüsten yapışkan salgı çıkarma dalı bu çizgiyle daha zayıf bağ kuran ayrı bir kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gözle görmeyi, görme duyusunu, bakan organı, kör olmayan kişiyi, dikkatle bakışı ve yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesini birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dalın ana kimliği bedensel görme alanıdır; kalp bilgisi veya delil anlamları bu dala taşınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal göz ve görme eylemiyle sınırlıdır; iç kavrayış ve kan, silah, taş ya da dikiş anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak görme duyusunu temel alır, fakat dikkatle bakma ve yavrunun göz açması gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı bağlı uzantılar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gözle görme alanı: görme duyusu, bakan göz organı, bir şeyi gözle görmek ve gözün görmeye açılması. Dikkatle dikilerek bakma veya yavrunun gözünün açılması gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Görme yetisine sahip kişi kör olanın karşıtı olarak adlandırılır.
Dikkatle ve keskin biçimde bakma, görme çekirdeğine bağlı kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır.
Yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesi de görme alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi bu dalı bedensel görmeye bağlar: göz organı, görme duyusu, gözle görme eylemi ve görme yetisi olan kişi. Aynı toplu iddia ayrıca yoğun bakış kalıbını ve yavrunun gözünün açılmasını çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Göz duyusu, göz organı ve gözle görme eylemini birlikte karşılayan en kısa doğal ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel görme çekirdeğini, gözle algılama eylemini ve görme yetisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz gözün gücü veya duyusu hakkında olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Duyu ve yeti tarafını korur.
error_profile.loses: Görme eylemini, göz organını ve kalıplaşmış bakış kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yoğun ve dikilerek bakma kalıbında kullanılmalıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Keskin bakış özel kullanımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel görme duyusu ve göz organı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dikkatle dikilerek bakış; belirgin ve sert durum

error_profile.preserves: Kavrama veya sezgi çağrışımı taşıyabilir.
error_profile.loses: Gözle görme duyusunu ve göz organını siler.
error_profile.adds: Kalbe ait anlayış ve sağgörü anlamı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün iç kavrayış dalıyla çakışır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de algılama ve ayırt etme dilinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda algı bedensel gözle olur; komşuda ise bilgi, delil ve iç kavrayış öne çıkar. Bu yüzden birbirinin yerine geçmezler.
